No chroma background, baked-in checkerboard, or matte. Output a transparent PNG cutout. Region: Warm wooden supply bundle with blank sign, no baked number, native alpha.

Include the full small stack, its loose white cord and its pale wooden front sign, with 8–10% clear transparent margins around all sides. Match the orange-tan sawn planks, dark brown cartoon edges and wood grain, roughly isometric three-quarter viewpoint and bright warm lighting. Change only the sign content: the sign face must be completely BLANK smooth wood so dynamic numbers can be laid over it. Remove the baked numeral 2 entirely. No letters, numbers, symbols or labels anywhere; no grass, flowers, ground, landscape, robot or UI. Genuine native transparent alpha, no white matte or checkerboard.
Targeted correction: preserve exactly the timber pile, rope, blank sign and rendering of Image 1, but SHRINK THE WHOLE OBJECT to occupy only 72% of the canvas width AND at most 72% of the canvas height, centered, creating a continuous generous transparent border of at least 12% on all four sides. The two bottom wooden supports must be fully visible with transparent space below them. No part of the timber, rope, sign, support feet or shadow may touch any canvas edge. Do not add anything or change any material, colors or geometry. Genuine transparent PNG; no matte.
